verdict.rationale: The product itself publishes an llms.txt (HTTP 200 at code.claude.com/llms.txt) and per-page .md docs endpoints, and the SDK/agent's own docs explicitly reference and link to the llms.txt index, showing the product is designed to be pointed at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of an agent actually consuming the llms.txt end-to-end, and no explicit user-facing feature for feeding llms.txt URLs into the SDK's query flow.
